policy.rule: Every input to build_loop.py must appear here with source_url, license, author, retrieved_utc, and sha256. Build refuses on missing entry, disallowed license, or hash drift. OWNER-GENERATED = footage the operator generated (Runway/Sora/Pika); source_url must record the generator and prompt card id (e.g. visual_prompts.md#VPC-001).
